children: expanded its Nvidia-backed AI Factory offerings, but shares fell approximately 7.04% to $451.70 as of 11:20 a.m. ET Thursday. The rollout spans desktop AI systems, servers and modular data centers. More products mean more opportunities to win business. They also raise the bar for execution.

Dell says AI Factory adoption topped 6,500 customers, versus 5,000 last quarterroughly 30% growth. Its fiscal-second-quarter results also showed $60.9 billion in AI-server orders, $16.4 billion in AI-server revenue and a $95 billion ending backlog. Demand looks substantial. The next test is turning those commitments into shipments, profits and cash.

The valuation snapshot puts Dell 87.19% above its $241.31 GF Value estimate, suggesting hefty growth expectations remain baked into the price despite the decline. That estimate is a valuation reference, not a guaranteed destination. Investors should watch AI-server margins, cash generation and backlog conversion: a huge order book matters most when fulfilling it produces attractive returns.

title: Dell Technologies Stocks Drop 7% as Agentic AI Factory Expands
